_comment: Curated coordination metadata overrides. Keyed by component dir (applies to all variants) with optional per-variant refinements under 'variants'. Merged over generated defaults by tools/add-coordination.mjs.

incompatibleWith.name: navbar
incompatibleWith.reason: Nested forms are invalid HTML; never place a form inside a nav form

agentPromptSequence: 1. Use this form element as the root container for a group of inputs
2. Add one label+input pair per field (text-input, select, checkbox, etc.)
3. Add a submit button as the last child
4. Link validation messages to inputs with aria-describedby

incompatibleWith.name: modal
incompatibleWith.reason: Header already establishes page chrome; nested modals in header break focus order

agentPromptSequence: 1. Place header as the first element in body
2. Nest navigation (primary, secondary) inside header
3. Pair with banner above it when a required-agency banner is needed
1. Place footer as the last element in body
2. Pair with identifier below it for official government branding
3. Keep footer nav links flat — no nested menus
1. Place banner as the very first element in body, above header
2. Keep the expand/collapse JS intact — it is required for the official.gov domain message
3. Do not add content inside the banner beyond the standard copy
1. Place identifier directly below the footer
2. Keep the required agency links and logo slots intact

incompatibleWith.name: button-group
incompatibleWith.reason: Button groups override individual button event handlers; style buttons directly instead

variantRules.note: Color variants are mutually exclusive (pick one); size and state classes combine with any color variant

agentPromptSequence: 1. Inside forms, set type='submit'; standalone buttons use type='button'
2. Use one primary button per view; other actions become secondary/outline
3. Place the button as the last interactive element of its form or section

incompatibleWith.name: button
incompatibleWith.reason: Do not nest individually-styled buttons; button-group manages its own segment styling

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place this input inside a form wrapper

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form wrapper first (unless one already exists)
2. Pair this input with a label element via matching for/id attributes
3. Link error/hint messages with aria-describedby
4. Add inputmode/autocomplete attributes where appropriate

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place this select inside a form wrapper

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form wrapper first (unless one already exists)
2. Pair with a label via for/id
3. For more than 7 options, prefer combo-box over select
4. Keep the first option as a placeholder ('- Select -')

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place this combo-box inside a form wrapper

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form wrapper first
2. Keep the underlying select element — JS enhances it, it must remain for no-JS fallback
3. Initialize after DOM ready (combo-box JS is required)

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place this date input inside a form wrapper

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form wrapper first
2. Keep the input type='text' with date format hint — JS replaces it with the calendar
3. Do not swap to type='date'; the USWDS calendar provides the accessible behavior

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place checkboxes inside a form wrapper

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form wrapper first
2. Use fieldset+legend when grouping related checkboxes
3. Keep each label associated via for/id

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place radios inside a form wrapper

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form wrapper first
2. Always wrap a radio group in fieldset+legend
3. Give every radio in a group the same name and unique id

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place this input inside a form wrapper

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place this input inside a form wrapper

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form wrapper first
2. Keep data-maxlength and the aria-live status region — both are required for announcements
3. Wrap the input and the message span in the character-count container

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Provides form context; place this input inside a form wrapper

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Validation summary belongs to a form; reference inputs by id

agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the validation summary above the form or at the top of the form
2. Link each error item to the offending input via anchor href='#input-id'
3. Move focus to the summary when validation fails (JS required)
1. Place alerts above the content they describe
2. For page-level status, pair with role='status' or role='alert' (keep the JS behavior)
3. Use site-alert for government-wide banners instead
1. Place site-alert above the header, below banner
2. Keep it dismissible only if persistence is handled (slim variant is static)
1. Use for key content the user must not miss (e.g. important callouts)
2. For error feedback, use validation + alert instead
1. Keep the accordion JS — without it all sections must render open
2. Keep button+region pairing (aria-controls/aria-expanded) intact
3. Do not nest accordions more than one level deep

incompatibleWith.name: header
incompatibleWith.reason: Do not place modals inside page chrome components; modal belongs at body level

incompatibleWith.name: form
incompatibleWith.reason: A form wrapper inside a modal is fine, but the modal itself must not be nested inside another form

agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the modal wrapper at the end of body
2. Keep open/close JS and focus trap intact
3. Trigger buttons reference the modal id via data attributes
1. Attach tooltips to interactive elements only (buttons, links)
2. Keep aria-describedby wiring — tooltip text must reach screen readers
3. Never put critical information solely in a tooltip

2. Provide a caption element — required for accessibility
3. Use scope='col'/'row' on headers; for sortable tables keep the JS

3. One primary action per card; the whole card may link if content is single-purpose

3. Pair with in-page-navigation only when page is long enough to warrant both

2. Keep usa-current highlighting in sync on scroll (JS required)
1. Place below the table or list it paginates
2. Keep aria-current='page' on the active page
3. Preserve prev/next aria-labels

prerequisiteComponents.name: form
prerequisiteComponents.reason: Search is a form submission; wrap in a form with role='search'

agentPromptSequence: 1. Wrap in form role='search' with action pointing to the search endpoint
2. Keep the visually-hidden label for screen readers
3. In header context, use the small variant
1. Place above multi-step form sections
2. Mark completed/current steps with status classes; keep aria attributes
3. Pair each step with its own form section or page

2. Keep hreflang and lang attributes on language links

agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch header first; navbar lives inside it
2. Keep the mobile menu toggle JS intact

incompatibleWith.name: modal
incompatibleWith.reason: Overlay is a low-level backdrop; use modal for interactive dialogs

2. Pair with in-page-navigation for long documents

2. Line length: cap body text near 68ch for readability
